explication: Perl is a general-purpose language interpreter. A user supplies a script, the interpreter reads and tokenizes source, parses it into operations, executes those operations, and produces output or system effects. The runtime supports scalar/array/hash values, procedural and object-oriented dispatch, regular expressions, Unicode and encoding transformations, file and process I/O, globbing, dynamic extensions, and platform-specific behavior. The sampled excerpts strongly evidence parsing state, regex execution, encoding, globbing, and OS adapters; several unsampled capabilities are represented only where the tree and README support them.
